# KappaO2 {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
KappaO2()
```
Variant 2 of the ordinal κ-chart ([`KappaO`](KappaO.qmd)); the marginal probabilities are kept fixed at their in-control values and only the agreement statistic is smoothed.
 


:::
